title.en: A line alive after a window never overdrew in it
title.zh: 窗后尚存之线未曾于窗内透支

statement.en: Persisting read in finite, dated form: a member at a step past a window of joint excess from a short stock rules that window out, and reads only windows closing before the member.
statement.zh: 以有限、有日期之形式读延续：于自短存量起之共同超出之窗后某步之成员，排除该窗；只读于该成员之前闭合之窗。

laws.en: Under balance, only active formations giving, activity needing support, descent, the renewal of a family of conditions gated on the family and every member of every cohort depending on it, each at a need of at least m, a line with a member at a step later than T + n never had the family's uptake exceed its replenishment for the n steps from T from a stock below n + m.
laws.zh: 在平衡、只有活动者给予、活动需支持、世系，一族条件之更新以该族为闸，且每代每个成员依存于它，各需至少 m 之下：一条于晚于 T + n 之步有成员之线，从未在自 T 起之 n 步中、自低于 n + m 之存量，族之摄取超过其补充。

hypotheses.en: No axiom. Balance; only active formations give; activity needs support; descent; the renewal of the family gated on it; every member of every cohort depending on the family; each at a need of at least m; one kind of relatum.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。平衡；只有活动者给予；活动需支持；世系；族之更新以族为闸；每代每个成员依存于族；各需至少 m；关系者为一种。

does_not_show.en: Anything of a window that closes at or after the member's step.
does_not_show.zh: 于成员之步或其后闭合之窗。

does_not_show.en: That the line chose to keep: persisting is a filter on what happened, not a mechanism forming an order.
does_not_show.zh: 该线选择了保持：延续是对所发生者之过滤，而非形成次序之机制。

validation_scope.en: Pure core, axiom reports empty; a leaf. Written by an AI; an AI reader of another model read the statements against the Lean, this record and the home section, cold, for overclaim (READER in the study folder); no human audit. Near-definitional compositions of the closure laws, with the witnesses checked on their models; none is new as mathematics.
validation_scope.zh: 纯核心，公理报告为空；叶模块。AI 所写；另一模型的一位 AI 读者对照 Lean、此记录与归属节冷读诸陈述，查是否言过其实（见研究目录 READER）；无人类审计。皆为闭包律之近于定义的组合，见证在其模型上检验；无一是新数学。

correspondence.en: A finite, dated form of a survival filter: a lineage observed alive at a time rules out the extinction-forcing windows that close before it.
correspondence.zh: 生存过滤之有限、有日期形式：于某时观察到尚存之世系，排除于其前闭合、迫其灭绝之窗。

next_delta.en: Read on a lineage that carries its reading: which windows a line alive at a step rules out for the scopes it reads.
next_delta.zh: 于携其读法之世系上读：一步尚存之线，对其所读之范围排除哪些窗。

detail.en: The premises of Flow.persists_never_overdraws, whose one use of persisting is this member.
detail.zh: Flow.persists_never_overdraws 之诸前提，其对延续之唯一用处即此成员。

The claim is unchanged.
